thread:
Maya (oncall): quick handoff — ongoing alert: embeddings-api p99 latency spike across eu-west and us-east. paging still firing. primary=maya, secondary=linus. :rotating_light:
IncidentBot: Pager: INCIDENT-EMB-2026 — p99 > 1.2s — active — 27 alerts in last 15m — severity: high
Maya (oncall): summary: started ~22:40 UTC, correlates with large regen fanout from customer X (high qps). caches not warm. mempressure on prim-sec embedding nodes showing evictions.
Linus: copying — any customer impact noted?
Noah - Support: Support logs show ~4% error rate for customers hitting long tail timeouts; a handful of sessions timed out and retried. Not widespread but one major account reported degraded UX.
Maya (oncall): mitigations in progress: 1) throttling rule applied to regen endpoint -> reduces burst. 2) prefetched warm caches on secondary nodes (partial). 3) temporary increase of secondary capacity (scale-up job kicked).
Srini: what's the status of fallback routing? can we route low-priority traffic to quantized-model pool?
Maya (oncall): yes — enabled policy: route=cost-tier->quantized-embed for non-SLA customers. command used: `redwood route set --policy regen-fanout --target quantized-embed --filter "!customer:enterprise"`
Olga: checked infra: primaries still at 78% mem, eviction rate spiked. KV-cache hitrate dropped to 58%. I pushed a config tweak to increase KV cache TTL for short-lived prefixes. Monitor will show effect in ~5m.
Linus: can you add a canary rollback option if scaling saturates other pools? we should be ready to revert routing.
Maya (oncall): noted. rollback snippet in runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/embeddings-fanout (section: rollback-routing). quick commands in runbook:
```
redwood route unset --policy regen-fanout
redwood scale set --pool quantized-embed --replicas 0
```
Srini: I started collecting p95/p99 before/after metrics via `infra-metrics query` and pushed a short grafana panel to the incident channel.
IncidentBot: Update: auto-escalation threshold crossed -> notify ENG-SRE if latency > 1.0s for another 10m
Maya (oncall): handoff notes for next shift: primary=Linus, secondary=Olga. action items: 1) keep throttles for regen endpoints active, 2) watch KV-cache hitrate and eviction_rate, 3) be ready to flip routing back if quantized pool latency or errors rise, 4) coordinate with Support for customer outreach to the affected account.
Linus: acked. I'll be on the bridge for the next 2h. Please drop any new logs or helm/scale commands here.
Noah - Support: I'll prepare a one-line status for the customer channel: "We’re mitigating increased response times for embeddings; we’ve applied rate controls and increased capacity — monitoring closely."
Olga: if we hit error rate > 2% on quantized pool, immediate rollback. I'll set an alert for that.
Maya (oncall): final: incident ticket linked -> INCIDENT-EMB-2026 in incident tracker. last state: mitigations applied, partial recovery, watch window requested 30m. passing primary to Linus now. :white_check_mark:
